ruleDefinitions.name: Raccine Uninstall
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects commands that indicate a Raccine removal from an end system. Raccine is a free ransomware protection tool.

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*taskkill\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*RaccineSettings\\\.exe.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*reg\\\.exe.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*delete.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Raccine\\ Tray.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*schtasks.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/DELETE.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Raccine\\ Rules\\ Updater.*")))
